scope: SEO scout taxonomy and six-page pilot; no article drafts
measurement_notes: Counts are the Wordstat response counts for the exact returned phrase; a seed totalCount is evidence for the seed phrase, not a forecast for a page.
Associations were reviewed for noise and are not treated as relevant demand unless an exact relevant phrase also appeared in results.
One page should own one intent; broad head terms remain taxonomy context and are not a request to create 1000 keyword pages.

overlap_risks: Overlaps with UX/UI fundamentals and design-system explanations.
Course, university and vacancy phrases indicate career intent and should not be mixed into a service or portfolio page.
Very broad head term overlaps with UI, web design and research; use a narrow task-led page instead.

clusters.intent: visual interface design and UI patterns
overlap_risks: UI/UX combined phrases occur in both UI and UX clusters; assign them to the page whose primary task is visual UI or end-to-end UX.
Largest head term and strongly education-led; a generic web-design page would cannibalize portfolio and redesign pages.
Overlaps with UI app design and UX interaction patterns; reserve for mobile-specific constraints and examples.

clusters.intent: design-system structure, tokens and reusable components
overlap_risks: Seed is noisy: electrical-system, information-system and unrelated atlas terms dominate associations. Keep evidence to UI/design-system matches.

clusters.intent: diagnose and improve an existing website
overlap_risks: Can overlap with generic web-design services; position around audit, before/after decisions and measurable UX improvements.

evidence: что такое кейс в работе дизайнера

overlap_risks: Career and portfolio-learning intent differs from client-service intent; keep as a portfolio guide or case index.
Close to UX fundamentals and motion; a page should focus on flow/state decisions, while motion owns timing and feedback.
The seed has gaming/mod noise in associations; target interface elements, app states and user feedback only.

clusters.intent: AI-assisted design workflow and tool selection
overlap_risks: Large interior-design and image-generation noise; avoid a generic AI tools list and anchor any page in interface/prototyping workflow.
Medical and generic examination associations are irrelevant; page should own practical UX research methods/interviews.

clusters.intent: make and validate a website prototype
overlap_risks: Overlaps with web design and AI prototyping; focus on structure, Figma flow and validation rather than finished visual design.

evidence: разработать интерфейс пользователя наиболее распространенные угрозы доступности

overlap_risks: Lower measured demand than broad UX/UI; keep it specific and evidence-led instead of inflating with unrelated associations.

candidate_pages.title: UX-исследование: методы и интервью для дизайнеров
overlap_risks: Keep separate from a general UX definition page and from a case-study page; own the research plan, interview and synthesis checklist.

candidate_pages.title: Прототип сайта в Figma: структура, сценарий и проверка
overlap_risks: Do not turn this into a generic website-design or AI-tool page; keep the deliverable a testable prototype.

candidate_pages.title: Доступность интерфейса: чеклист для веб-интерфейса

query_evidence.match: разработать интерфейс пользователя наиболее распространенные угрозы доступности

overlap_risks: Demand is smaller and evidence is sparse; page must be concrete, useful and truthful about standards/testing coverage.

candidate_pages.title: Анимация интерфейса: состояния, обратная связь и плавные переходы
overlap_risks: Exclude game-mod meanings from the seed neighborhood; keep motion tied to feedback, transitions and reduced-motion behavior.

candidate_pages.title: UI-дизайн система: компоненты, токены и правила
overlap_risks: The seed is noisy; title and content must qualify UI/design systems and avoid electrical or information-system meanings.

candidate_pages.title: Редизайн сайта: как провести аудит и собрать план улучшений
overlap_risks: Keep the page process-led and diagnostic; avoid competing with portfolio case pages or a generic web-design service page.

intent.pilot_sequence: research -> prototype -> accessibility -> motion -> design-system -> redesign
intent.selection_rule: Choose distinct practical jobs-to-be-done with at least one exact relevant query match beyond the seed; prioritize evidence quality and portfolio fit over seed volume.

frequency.interpretation: Wordstat counts are directional demand evidence for Russia region 225. They are not traffic forecasts, conversion estimates or current rankings.

overlap_risks: Broad UX, UI and web-design seeds overlap heavily; keep the six pilot pages task-specific.
Design-system, AI-design and accessibility seeds contain association noise; only relevant exact results support page selection.
Portfolio pages and educational how-to pages should not compete for the same title or primary intent.

recommended_priority.pilot: Build the six candidate pages in listed order after validating internal-link and route strategy.
recommended_priority.backlog: Retain the remaining eight clusters as topic coverage and future candidates; do not generate pages from seed volume alone.
